duplicate_transaction: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID FROM TRANSACTIONS GROUP BY TRANSACTION_ID HAVING COUNT(*)>1
duplicate_risk_key: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID FROM TRANSACTION_RISK GROUP BY TRANSACTION_ID HAVING COUNT(*)>1
missing_accounts: SELECT t.TRANSACTION_ID FROM TRANSACTIONS t LEFT JOIN ACCOUNTS a ON t.ACCOUNT_ID=a.ACCOUNT_ID WHERE a.ACCOUNT_ID IS NULL
missing_merchants: SELECT t.TRANSACTION_ID FROM TRANSACTIONS t LEFT JOIN MERCHANTS m ON t.MERCHANT_ID=m.MERCHANT_ID WHERE m.MERCHANT_ID IS NULL
invalid_amount: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE AMOUNT_GBP IS NULL OR AMOUNT_GBP<=0
invalid_timestamp: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE datetime(TX_TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
risk_coverage: SELECT t.TRANSACTION_ID FROM TRANSACTIONS t LEFT JOIN TRANSACTION_RISK r ON t.TRANSACTION_ID=r.TRANSACTION_ID WHERE r.TRANSACTION_ID IS NULL
valid_alert_flags: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID FROM TRANSACTION_RISK WHERE ALERT_FLAG NOT IN (0,1) OR ALERT_FLAG IS NULL
one_row_per_join: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID FROM V_RISK_DETAIL GROUP BY TRANSACTION_ID HAVING COUNT(*)<>1
confusion_matrix_identity: SELECT POLICY_ID FROM THRESHOLD_METRICS WHERE TP+FP<>ALERT_COUNT OR TP+FP+FN+TN<>TRANSACTION_COUNT
no_bad_review_reference: SELECT r.REVIEW_ID FROM REVIEWS r LEFT JOIN TRANSACTIONS t ON t.TRANSACTION_ID=r.TRANSACTION_ID WHERE t.TRANSACTION_ID IS NULL
